card.name: Digits inside DOI, ISBN and ISSN codes
card.fires_on: A single digit, often 5, 3 or 1, right after the start of a reference identifier such as a DOI prefix 10.1, an ISBN 1- or an ISSN. It also fires on the digit after a comma in a number like 13/13,176.

modes.label: Reference identifiers
modes.description: The digit just after the opening part of a DOI, ISBN, ISSN or PMID in a citation list.

modes.label: Digit after comma in counts
modes.description: The first digit of the last group in a large count with a comma, in trial results.
modes.example: showed an increase in asthma-related deaths in patients receiving salmeterol (13/13,<<1>>76 in patients treated with salmeter

card.plain: It fires on a number digit inside the long ID codes of citations, such as DOI and ISBN numbers.
